scripts.format:check: prettier --check . || (echo 'Formatting issues found. Run `pnpm format` to fix them.' >&2 && exit 1)
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

//.pnpm.overrides glob@^13: Raises glob 13 to 14.0.2 or later for GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (an aborted walk keeps reading directories; https://github.com/bgoleno/opportun/issues/39). glob reaches the server at runtime through @fastify/static, whose latest release (10.1.8) still depends on glob ^13. Remove this entry once a @fastify/static release depends on glob 14.0.2 or later and the lockfile resolves glob to 14.0.2 or later without it.
//.pnpm.overrides minimatch@^10: Raises minimatch 10 to 11.0.1 or later for GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (pattern amplification; https://github.com/bgoleno/opportun/issues/39). minimatch arrives through glob 13 (above) and, for linting, through eslint, @eslint/config-array and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, whose latest releases (10.14.0, 0.23.5, 8.72.1) still depend on minimatch ^10. Remove this entry once those three depend on minimatch 11.0.1 or later and the lockfile resolves minimatch to 11.0.1 or later without it.
